verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs claim seamless integration with Hugging Face models and support for 200+ model architectures on Hugging Face. They also describe running Hub models with custom code via `--trust-remote-code` and falling back to the Transformers modeling backend. A community comment credits its 'huge model library' as a key strength. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the automatic download/caching workflow from the Hub (e.g., model ID resolution, gated-model auth), and hands-on independent corroboration of pulling and running a model end-to-end.
